summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun standalone runtime from GitHub releases to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` file. The loader (`setup.mjs`) is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifiers and per-function string-map dispatch objects. The executed file `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle beginning `// @bun @bun-cjs` and using a string-array plus rotation obfuscator (`WV8StW` function rotates an array of encoded strings). No source or build configuration for `math_init.js` ships in the package. The package advertises key-value storage functionality — a second language runtime is unrelated to that purpose. The delivery matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the payload runs on `npm install` under a freshly fetched non-Node runtime, and its contents are deliberately unreadable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
